## 🚀 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of the requested feature.

## 💡 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

Describe the solution or feature capabilities you'd like to see implemented.

If applicable, describe UI/UX expectations or visual preferences.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup sketches, or screenshots about the feature request here.
